'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Mike Tomashewski LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Tomashewski]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: TRM ...... IN SPACE!. Transcription note: line 59 has a struck word before the ditto marks

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
